prompt_text: Who does backflow testing and repair near Liberty MO?
competitors_mentioned: Mr. Rooter Plumbing of Kansas City
answer_verbatim:
For Liberty, MO (64068), start with the **City of Liberty Water/Utilities Department**—they can tell you whether they require a tester from an approved list and what test-report form to submit. City Hall/utility billing is commonly reached at **816-439-4537**.

Companies serving the Kansas City Northland/Liberty area that commonly handle backflow testing and, when licensed/certified, repairs include:

- **A.B. May** — plumbing and backflow-preventer service in the KC metro  
- **Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup of Kansas City** — testing/repair availability varies by technician  
- **Mr. Rooter Plumbing of Kansas City** — plumbing and backflow-related work  
- **Local licensed commercial plumbing contractors in Liberty/Kansas City North** — often the best option for irrigation-system, restaurant, medical, or commercial backflow assemblies

Before scheduling, ask these two questions:

1. **“Is your technician certified to test backflow prevention assemblies accepted by the City of Liberty?”**  
2. **“Can you repair the assembly and submit/file the test report with the water provider if it fails?”**

Not every plumber who can replace a valve is authorized to perform the official annual test, so confirming that certification up front matters. For an irrigation backflow device, an irrigation contractor with a certified backflow tester may also be a good fit.
